title: numericSelector: add a defaultHeader option
body:
Following #665 

To be able to provide the "Select a value" select option value.

In numericSelector it would mean clearRefinements when it's selected.

comments.body:
This should be solved individually by the user, I do not believe this is a good UX approach when there's an already selected value. It will hide context from the user, better select good labels.

If we have valid use cases where having a numeric selector and an undefined value makes sense, open a new issue.
